name: Runtime Identity & Release Metadata Hotfix
changes: Makes server, UI, version.txt, build manifest, and SAB download-engine adapter identity coherent at v3.7.2.
Moves the SABCTools-integrated server/UI runtime into public source directly instead of transforming frozen v3.7.0 blobs during packaging.
Updates README, website fallback labels, build/source documentation, and GitHub Pages publication behavior for the current release.
Documents bundled SABCTools 9.6.3 and includes its GPL-2.0-or-later license text in release payloads.
regression_guards: Every shipped runtime identity is validated independently before publication.
Current build and workflow paths may not invoke the historical v3.7.1 runtime transformer.
SABCTools remains pinned to 9.6.3 at the reviewed upstream commit and NewzDeckYenc.exe remains forbidden from new payloads.
README and website fallback release identities must match the source version before publication.
preserved: v3.7.1 SABCTools decoder behavior and split NNTP fetch/decode architecture.
Private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Direct Unpack/post-processing, article cache, async disk, Automation, Smart Import, Newsgroup Browser, Backup & Restore, and all twelve themes.
Windows launcher, service, tray, picker, thumbnail helper, and installed-upgrade retired-yEnc cleanup behavior.
